goal: Compute headers presync DoS parameters dynamically at startup instead of hardcoding them in releases
Saves maintainers from manual release script runs and adapts parameters over time without guessing lifetime
reviewability: All reviewer questions and model fixes have been addressed
agreement: Strong support after reviewing the revised parameter calculation from scratch (darosior)
Addressed edge-case solver hangs and presync height overflow on timewarp chains (shuv-amp)
Addressed concern that runtime clock values could leak node timing or anonymity (ajtowns)
Concept and approach approval from several contributors (sedited, ajtowns, fjahr)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it strengthens DoS protection during headers presync by fixing an attack rate modeling flaw
